Pause Freenet on mobile data. It runs only on Wi-Fi and other unmetered networks.
Pause Freenet when the phone is not charging. A nearly empty battery always stops it.

Freenet mobile v%1$s

Runs Freenet v%2$s on your phone. This is an unofficial build, not made by The Freenet Project.

Telemetry and automatic updates are turned off. The web interface can only be reached from this phone.

App code: GNU GPL v3, based on freenet-mobile/app.
Freenet: GNU AGPL, source at freenet/freenet-core.
I understand that this app connects my phone to a peer-to-peer network and shares data with other people. Learn more about Freenet.
It starts again by itself when Wi-Fi or the charger comes back. You can change this in the settings.
Invalid name: use lowercase letters, numbers and -.
Start Freenet first: the site is published through it.

The site becomes public. Other people may keep copies, and it may stay on the network even if you change it later. Do not publish personal data. The key to update the site stays on this phone: if you uninstall the app you can no longer update it.
Publishing, this can take a few minutes…
Once a day, when the app opens, it asks GitHub if there is a new version. You always confirm before installing.
